# Data Codebook

The codebook is available directly on the [Data page](data.html#codebook)

## Codebook

Both downloaded datasets contain only these four variables

<table>
<thead><tr><th>Variable</th><th>Definition</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><code>district_id</code></td><td><ul><li>District identifier from 1 to 832</li><li>The same identifier follows a district across all seven years</li></ul></td></tr>
<tr><td><code>year</code></td><td><ul><li>Study year from 1 to 7</li><li>Not a calendar year</li></ul></td></tr>
<tr><td><code>treatment_start_year</code></td><td><ul><li>First treated year is 5 or 6</li><li>The traditional DID dataset has only Year 5 adopters</li><li>0 means never treated</li></ul></td></tr>
<tr><td><code>outcome_std</code></td><td><ul><li>Simulated achievement measured in SD units</li><li>Untreated outcomes are standardized across all districts and years before effects are added</li><li>The final observed outcome is not standardized again</li></ul></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

An effect of **0.20 SD** represents an increase equal to one fifth of the untreated outcome's standard deviation

In the lab, we create the treatment indicators from treatment_start_year and year
